faction.name: Adeptus Custodes
faction.data_source: 40kdc-data 1.4.5 (11th edition) + Wahapedia 11e codex import 2026-10-16 (Codex: Orks, Codex: Adeptus Custodes)

abilities.name: Martial Ka'tah
abilities.description:
At the start of your Command phase, friendly Adeptus Custodes units with this ability are readied. While a friendly unit is readied, you can select one of the ka'tah abilities presented below for that unit to use. If you do, that unit is no longer readied.
Each ka'tah ability will tell you when that ka'tah ability can be used, and the effects that ka'tah ability has on the unit using it.
We recommend placing a token next to each readied unit, removing it when that unit is no longer readied.
Favoured Ka'tah
Many of the most prominent shield hosts favour a specific martial ka'tah above all others.
All detachments tagged 'Unique: Shield Host' state a Favoured Ka'tah. If you selected one of these detachments, the ka'tah ability that is the Favoured Ka'tah of that detachment grants the additional effect listed in that detachment.
Example: If you selected the Solar Watch detachment, when you select the Calistus ka'tah ability for a readied unit, that unit has +2" M in addition to the normal effect of Calistus.

abilities.name: Deep Strike
abilities.description: The unit has the Deep Strike ability.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description: The unit gains the Leader ability.

abilities.name: Aegis of the Emperor
abilities.description: Friendly Adeptus Custodes units with this ability have Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

abilities.name: Swift Onslaught
abilities.description:
This unit can:
• Re-roll advance rolls.
• Re-roll charge rolls.

abilities.name: Sword of the Throne
abilities.description:
At the start of the first battle round, select one enemy unit to be this model's mark:
• This model's attacks that target this model's mark have +1 to wound rolls.
• Each time this model's mark is destroyed, select one enemy unit to be this model's mark.

abilities.name: Scouts 7"
abilities.description: Before the first battle round, the unit can make a Scout move of up to 7".

abilities.name: Daughters of the Abyss
abilities.description:
• Friendly Anathema Psykana units with this ability have Feel No Pain 3+ against psychic attacks.
• Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units with this ability have the following ability:
Psychic Null (Aura): Friendly Adeptus Custodes units within 6" of this unit have Feel No Pain 5+ against psychic attacks.

abilities.name: Sanctified Flames
abilities.description: In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll if that enemy unit is a PSYKER unit.

abilities.name: Damaged: 1-5 Wounds Remaining
abilities.description:
DAMAGED24.39
This ability always takes the form Damaged X. While a model's remaining wounds are equal to or less than X, that model is damaged: while damaged, that model's attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

abilities.name: Deadly Demise D3
abilities.description:
Before this model is removed from play:
  -> Roll one D6: on a 6+, each enemy unit within 6" suffers D3 mortal wounds.
